caseName: Olbers v. U. S. Shipping Board Emergency Fleet Corp.
caseNameFull: Iver Olbers v. U. S. Shipping Board Emergency Fleet Corporation
attorneys: Mr. J. Frank Staley, Special Assistant to the Attorney General, with whom Solicitor General Beck and Assistant Attorney General Letts were on the brief, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Chicago Junction Ry. Co., 222 U. S. 222, 224; Boehmer v. Pennsylvania R. R. Co., 252 U. S. 495, 498. Mr. S. B. Axtell for plaintiff in error.
